explanation: I grepped Mathlib, Batteries and Lean core for `bit_ne_zero`, `bit_eq_zero` and related names. The closest match is `Nat.bit_ne_zero` in Mathlib/Data/Nat/Bits.lean. It only gives the one direction `n ≠ 0 → bit b n ≠ 0`, not the iff `n.bit b ≠ 0 ↔ (n = 0 → b = true)`. The only other relevant declaration is `Nat.bit_eq_zero_iff`, which sits in the same file as the target and is what its `simp` proof uses. Lean core has no `Nat.bit`, and I found nothing relevant in Batteries.
